description: This Swift source file defines enums and structs related to remote gateway authentication issues and probe results, as well as a function to asynchronously run a remote gateway probe with SSH and WebSocket URL validation.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayAuthIssue
classes.description: Enumeration of various authentication issues that can occur when connecting to a remote gateway, with initializers and properties for UI display and messaging.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeResult
classes.description: Enumeration representing the possible outcomes of a remote gateway probe, including success, specific auth issues, and failures.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeSuccess
classes.description: Details about a successful remote gateway connection, including the source of authentication and descriptive title and detail messages.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbe
classes.description: Utility class containing the static run() method to perform an asynchronous probe of the remote gateway, including WS URL validation, SSH validation, and health snapshot.

methods.name: RemoteGatewayProbe.run
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check of the remote gateway's status, including URL validation, SSH checks, and connection health, returning a detailed result.

methods.name: RemoteGatewayProbe.isValidWsUrl
methods.description: Validates if the provided WebSocket URL is correctly normalized for the remote gateway.

methods.name: RemoteGatewayProbe.sshCheckCommand
methods.description: Constructs an SSH command to verify SSH connectivity to the target with specified options.

methods.name: RemoteGatewayProbe.formatSSHFailure
methods.description: Formats the failure message based on the SSH command response.
